title: Sparkly cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE033'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseSide' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E69500'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseFront' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFCA28'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F5A623'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- cheese top face -->
  <polygon points='18,42 82,42 50,18' fill='url(#cheeseTop)'/>
  <!-- cheese right/front face -->
  <polygon points='18,42 82,42 82,74 18,74' fill='url(#cheeseFront)'/>
  <!-- cheese side face (depth) -->
  <polygon points='82,42 82,74 50,50 50,18' fill='url(#cheeseSide)' opacity='0.001'/>

  <!-- make a proper wedge: redo with a simple wedge shape -->
  <!-- top face -->
  <polygon points='22,48 78,48 50,22' fill='#FFE033'/>
  <!-- left face -->
  <polygon points='22,48 50,22 50,58 22,84' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <!-- right face -->
  <polygon points='78,48 50,22 50,58 78,84' fill='#FFD54F'/>

  <!-- holes on top -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='38' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#E6A800'/>

  <!-- holes on left face -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='62' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#D99800'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='76' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#D99800'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='52' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#D99800'/>

  <!-- holes on right face -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='60' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#DDB000'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='74' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#DDB000'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='50' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#DDB000'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <!-- sparkle 1 top left -->
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <polygon points='10,12 12,18 18,20 12,22 10,28 8,22 2,20 8,18'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 2 top right -->
  <g fill='#FFF9C4'>
    <polygon points='88,10 89.5,15 94,16.5 89.5,18 88,23 86.5,18 82,16.5 86.5,15'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 3 bottom left -->
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <polygon points='6,72 7.5,77 12,78.5 7.5,80 6,85 4.5,80 0,78.5 4.5,77'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 4 bottom right small -->
  <g fill='#FFF9C4'>
    <polygon points='92,80 93,84 97,85 93,86 92,90 91,86 87,85 91,84'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 5 top middle -->
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <polygon points='50,4 51,8 55,9 51,10 50,14 49,10 45,9 49,8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='16' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='92' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='94' r='1.2' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
</svg>
